theater: 兩河下游烏爾城與埃蘭邊境

battle.name: 烏爾第三王朝的滅亡
battle.theater: 兩河下游烏爾城與埃蘭邊境
battle.brief: 公元前二〇〇四年，埃蘭王伊杜什聯合安尚與希馬什基的聯軍自東方壓下，圍困蘇美最南的大城烏爾。末代國王伊比辛死守城垣，屢遣車兵與矛兵出城反擊，終因糧援斷絕而城破，王與王室被擄往蘇薩。守軍列陣所倚的，正是銅矛、銅斧與弓弩；本卡那件早王朝的埃及長矛，正是同樣束柄銅矛的同型兵器。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 交戰的兩方，是南美索不達米亞的烏爾第三王朝，與以埃蘭為主的聯軍。烏爾方由國王本人兼最高統帥，王國的權力架構是家長式的：國王之下設掌行政與軍務的大宰（sukkalmah），像舒辛朝的阿拉德穆，既是總理又兼基爾蘇行省總督；各行省設民政總督（ensi2）主管稅賦、司法與人口，另有軍事總督（šagina，即將軍）專管駐軍，後者多由王族與國王親信出任，任期不長，以免地方勢力坐大。各城之下另有率數百人的「nu-banda3」一級指揮官，帝國各處的常備隊由這套分層指揮系統調度。埃蘭方面，國王居於蘇薩，率埃蘭步兵與車兵；參戰的聯盟包括安尚、希馬什基等伊朗高原城邦的分遣隊，後世文本有時直接把這些部隊稱為埃蘭人。除了正面兩方，阿摩利特（馬爾圖）部族在北方不斷越牆而入，古提餘部與中部各城趁亂恢復自治，蘇美爾的河運與商路因此中斷。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Third Dynasty of Ur in southern Mesopotamia and a coalition led by Elam. On the Ur side the king himself was the supreme commander, and the state's structure was patrimonial: below the king sat the grand vizier (sukkalmah) who handled both administration and military affairs, such as Aradmu in the reign of Shu-Sin, who was at once prime minister and governor of the rich province of Girsu; each province had a civil governor (ensi2) in charge of taxation, justice and the population, and beside him a military governor (šagina, that is, a general) who commanded the garrisons, these latter usually drawn from the royal family and the king's close associates and moved about frequently so that they would not acquire a local base of their own. Below the cities sat commanders of a lower grade, the nu-banda3, each heading a few hundred men, and the standing forces distributed across the empire were worked through this hierarchy. On the Elamite side the king sat at Susa with Elamite foot and war wagons; the coalition included detachments from Anshan and Shimashki, the highland states of the Iranian plateau, and later texts sometimes call these troops simply Elamites. Besides the two sides in the field, Amorite (Martu) groups kept pressing in from the north across the frontier wall, while Gutian remnants and the cities of the middle country recovered their autonomy in the confusion, cutting the river traffic and the trade routes of Sumer.
people: 五位君主是這場滅亡的時序骨架。開國者烏爾納瑪約前二一一二年即位；他的前任烏圖赫伽爾曾擊敗古提王提里甘，烏爾納瑪在烏圖赫伽爾統治約八年之後，以烏爾總督的身分奪位，整合南部城邦，創建常備軍，頒布現存最早的《烏爾納瑪法典》，興建烏爾的神塔與城牆，最後死在東方高原的戰場上，在位約十八年。其子舒爾吉在位約四十八年，幾乎是王朝的一半；他取「四方之王」的號，統一度量衡，制定王室曆法，設「書吏之家」培育抄寫員，在阿卡德北面築長城抵擋阿摩利特，並把王國推向安尚、蘇薩與北方山地；後世為他立廟，他的名聲被寫成頌歌。阿馬爾辛在位九年，舒辛亦九年；舒辛重建北方防禦牆，晚年實權落到宰相阿拉德穆手上。最後一位是伊比辛，在位約二十四年：前三年之後核心行省的行政文書幾乎中斷，第十四年起不再有遠征東方，安尚、胡努爾、蘇薩早已自治，埃什努那與伊辛相繼脫離，饑荒蔓延全國，他卻仍在烏爾維持統治約二十年。攻方是埃蘭王伊杜什（Iddin-Migan，亦見稱作 Rid-Adad），聯軍中安尚與希馬什基的諸王隨行；另有伊辛總督伊什比埃拉趁亂自立，另立正統。
peopleEn: Five monarchs give the skeleton of the sequence. The founder Ur-Namma took the throne about 2112 BC; his predecessor Utu-hegal had defeated the Gutian king Tirigan, and Ur-Namma seized the throne after some eight years of Utu-hegal's rule, stepping up from his position as governor of Ur. He united the southern city-states, created the standing army, promulgated the earliest surviving code of law, the Code of Ur-Namma, built the ziggurat of Ur and the city's wall, and was finally killed on a battlefield in the eastern highlands after about eighteen years on the throne. His son Shulgi reigned about forty-eight years, nearly half the dynasty; he took the title of king of the four corners, standardised weights and measures, established the royal calendar, set up the House of Tablets to train scribes, built a long wall north of Akkad to hold back the Amorites, and pushed the kingdom towards Anshan, Susa and the northern highlands; temples were later built for him and his name was turned into hymn. Amar-Sin reigned nine years, and Shu-Sin nine as well; Shu-Sin rebuilt the northern defensive wall, and in his last years real power passed to the chancellor Aradmu. The last was Ibbi-Sin, who reigned about twenty-four years: from the third year onward the administrative documents of the core provinces dried up, from the fourteenth year he no longer campaigned in the east, Anshan, Huhnur and Susa had long been autonomous, Eshnunna and Isin broke away in turn, and famine spread across the country, yet he held on in Ur for roughly twenty years. On the attacking side stood the Elamite king Iduš (Iddin-Migan, also rendered Rid-Adad), with the kings of Anshan and Shimashki accompanying him in the coalition; and separately, the governor of Isin, Ishbi-Erra, broke away in the confusion and set up a rival legitimate line.
kits: 本卡兵器是埃及長矛：早王朝時期把銅或青銅矛頭套在木杆上的步戰長矛，埃及人用它守住城垣的缺口，也在異族入主時用來收復失地。前二〇〇四年前後，埃及正處於第一中間期末段、第十一王朝重新統一的前夜，赫拉克利奧波利斯與孟斐斯兩方仍在爭鬥；待孟陶赫特普二世把常備軍整頓起來，步兵才重新以銅與青銅的矛斧為骨幹。因此本卡那件兵器，與烏爾城下蘇美士兵手中的長矛同屬束柄銅矛這一類，並無年代上的障礙；兩地的差別只在意匠與配備，而不在形制。蘇美方面的步戰裝備包括：銅或青銅的葉形矛頭、銅斧、短匕首、銅與燧石箭鏃、複合弓與投石索；防具是大面積的長方形柳條蒙皮盾，烏爾出土的《烏爾攻城》陶板所刻的那名攀城者，手中就是這樣一面大盾，肩側帶著一支長矛。車兵是四輪戰車，挽具是野驢——馬匹要到前十八世紀才傳入美索不達米亞；到這個時代，步兵才是烏爾軍的骨幹，車只用於側翼與王室儀仗。攻城方備有土坡、雲梯與火攻器械，守方有烏爾納瑪修築的燒磚城牆、護城河與通河渠的碼頭；城中的聖域與三層高的神塔，底面約六十四乘四十五米、總高約三十米，是全城最要害的目標，也是埃蘭人最想砸掉的東西。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Egyptian spear: a foot weapon of the Early Dynastic period, with a copper or bronze head socketed onto a wooden shaft, used by the Egyptians to hold the gaps in their fortification walls and, later, to recover lost ground when foreigners took the country. Around 2004 BC Egypt stood at the end of the First Intermediate Period, on the eve of the reunification under the Eleventh Dynasty, with Herakleopolis and Memphis still struggling for the land; only when Mentuhotep II put the standing army back in order did the infantry again rest on copper and bronze spears and axes. The weapon on this card therefore stands in the same class as the spears in the hands of the Sumerian soldiers below the walls of Ur, and there is no chronological obstacle to the comparison: the difference between the two lies in workmanship and in what was carried alongside, not in the form itself. The Sumerian foot equipment included copper or bronze leaf-shaped spearheads, copper axes, short daggers, copper and flint arrowheads, composite bows, and the sling; the defensive item was a large rectangular shield of withy covered in hide, and the Siege of Ur plaque from the excavations shows just such a big shield in the hand of the man climbing the wall, with a spear at his shoulder. The war wagon was a four-wheeled car drawn by onagers — horses did not reach Mesopotamia until the eighteenth century BC — and by this time the infantry was the backbone of the Ur army, the wagon serving with the flank and with royal display. The besiegers had ramps, ladders and fire; the defenders had the baked-brick wall built by Ur-Namma, the moat, and the quays that linked the city to the canals; and in the middle of the city stood the sacred precinct and its three-tiered ziggurat, about sixty-four by forty-five metres at the base and some thirty metres high, the most precious target in the town and the thing the Elamites most wanted to break.
tactics: 這場戰爭的樣式，是一次成功的包圍加一次決定性的攻城。埃蘭聯軍先不打烏爾本城，而是掃清東面與北面的衛星城和渡口，切斷烏爾與阿卡德、圖瑪勒方向的聯絡，讓這座城在北方盟邦與中部行省之間徹底孤立；北面那道由舒爾吉與舒辛先後加固的長城，本是為阿摩利特而設，擋不住從東方高原壓下來的埃蘭人。包圍既成，攻方用土坡與雲梯貼近城牆，以投石與火攻消耗城頭的守備；大英博物館所藏的《烏爾攻城》陶板留住了這一幕：一名士兵舉著大長方盾攀在城牆上，盾與矛合成一個可以緩慢上升的殼子。守方則以步兵列陣於城牆之後與內街，盾牆在前，矛手在後，等敵人爬上城頭才以矛、斧、投石索招呼；伊比辛也屢次以車兵與步兵出城反擊，試圖在缺口上把圍城者趕開，但每次出城都耗盡城中的人力與糧食。真正的致命處在後勤：巴爾達輪流繳納制在伊比辛即位之初便告廢止，各行省不再按月向中央繳納穀物、蘆葦與牲畜，饑荒之下城內存糧見底，守軍飢疲，圍困本身便要完成剩下的工作——只要封住河渠、斷掉牧場與柴薪，城市就會自己垮掉。城破之後，防守潰散，王與王室被押往蘇薩，聖域被掠劫與焚毀。
tacticsEn: The shape of this war is one successful encirclement followed by one decisive siege. The Elamite coalition did not strike the city of Ur directly at first; it swept the satellite towns and fords to the east and north, cut Ur off from Akkad and from the north-western allies, and left the city isolated between the northern powers and the provinces of the middle country. The long wall in the north, reinforced in turn by Shulgi and Shu-Sin, had been raised against the Amorites and could not stop an enemy pressing down from the eastern highlands. Once the ring was closed, the besiegers brought ramps and ladders up to the wall and wore down the defenders with stones and fire; the Siege of Ur plaque in the British Museum preserves the moment, a man climbing the wall behind a large rectangular shield, his spear at his shoulder, shield and spear together forming a shell that could rise slowly. The defenders formed up with infantry behind the wall and in the inner streets, shields in front and spearmen behind, waiting for the enemy to top the wall before meeting them with spear, axe and sling; Ibbi-Sin also launched repeated sorties with wagon and foot to drive the besiegers off the breach, but each sortie drained the city of men and grain. The fatal point lay in the rear: the bala rotation system lapsed at the very beginning of Ibbi-Sin's reign, the provinces no longer delivered grain, reeds and livestock to the centre month by month, famine emptied the stores inside the walls, and the garrison grew too hungry to hold; the blockade alone would finish the work, for a city cut off from the canals, the pastures and the firewood collapses on its own. After the breach the defence came apart, the king and the royal household were taken off to Susa, and the sacred precinct was looted and burned.
data: 可以核對的數字大致如下。年代上，烏爾第三王朝在通行中年代下為前二一一二年至前二〇〇四年，約一百零八年；低年代作前二〇四八至前一九四〇年，極低年代作前二〇四八至前一九一一年，絕對年代至今仍有爭議。五位君主的在位年數大致是：烏爾納瑪約十八年、舒爾吉約四十八年、阿馬爾辛九年、舒辛九年、伊比辛約二十四年；《蘇美爾王表》在烏爾第三王朝一段只列四王，缺了舒辛，而舒辛的年名卻在當年文書中大量留存。五人之中以舒爾吉在位最久，王朝崩潰則落在伊比辛治末。文書保存量之大是這一時期的特色：估計出土的行政泥板約十二萬片，二〇一六年的清點只有約六萬四千五百片得到科學出版，其中吉爾蘇（泰羅）與烏瑪兩地就佔了一半。國家機關的規模也留下數字：中央牲畜局一年可調運約七萬頭羊；烏瑪行省王室拓殖者佔人口三分之二，寺廟土地只佔全境百分之七，卻有一萬三千公頃以上；吉爾蘇一處作坊管理約六千名工人。烏爾的神塔底面約六十四乘四十五米，總高約三十米，三層平台，今日所見多為前六世紀那波尼都斯重建的部分。烏爾城在北緯三十點九六度、東經四十六點一〇度。至於兩軍人數、圍城長短與守軍損耗，沒有留下可靠計數，文本只說圍困歷時甚久。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. On dating, the Third Dynasty of Ur runs from 2112 to 2004 BC in the Middle Chronology normally used, about a hundred and eight years; the Low Chronology gives 2048 to 1940 BC and the Ultra Low 2048 to 1911 BC, and the absolute dates remain disputed. The reigns of the five monarchs come to roughly: Ur-Namma about eighteen years, Shulgi about forty-eight, Amar-Sin nine, Shu-Sin nine, and Ibbi-Sin about twenty-four. The Sumerian King List gives only four kings for this section of Ur, omitting Shu-Sin, even though Shu-Sin's year names survive in quantity in the documents of the time. Shulgi is the longest-reigning of the five, and the collapse falls in the closing years of Ibbi-Sin. The sheer volume of written material is a feature of the period: an estimated 120,000 administrative tablets have come down, and a 2016 inventory found only about 64,500 of them published scientifically, with Girsu (Tello) and Umma alone accounting for half of them. The scale of the institutions left figures too: the central livestock agency could move some 70,000 sheep in a single year; in the province of Umma royal settlers made up two thirds of the population, while temple lands took only seven per cent of the area but exceeded 13,000 hectares; one workshop office at Girsu administered about 6,000 workers. The ziggurat of Ur had a base of about sixty-four by forty-five metres and a total height near thirty metres across three platforms, and what stands today is largely the rebuilding of the sixth-century BC king Nabonidus. The city of Ur lay at 30.96 degrees north and 46.10 degrees east. As for the numbers of troops on either side, the length of the siege and the losses of the garrison, no reliable count survives; the texts say only that the blockade lasted a long time.
cause: 把這場滅亡拆開看，是四層原因疊在一起。第一層是結構性的：烏爾第三王朝把整個南部兩河平原綁在一套高度集中的行政與分配體系上，巴爾達輪流繳納制把各行省的穀物、蘆葦、牲畜與人力按月抽調到中央，一旦行省總督發現王權轉弱，便立即恢復自治，帝國的解體因此從邊緣一路退到中心。第二層是邊患：與埃蘭諸王屢戰屢和而終究不能安撫，埃蘭控制下的安尚、希馬什基一帶時叛時服；西北方的阿摩利特部族越過舒爾吉與舒辛修築的長城持續滲入，把征召、稅賦與糧道一併拖垮。第三層是王朝末期的人事與行政崩解：伊比辛即位後第三年起，核心行省的行政中心便不再出文書；第十四年之後對安尚、胡努爾、蘇薩的遠征全部停止；埃什努那與伊辛先後脫離，饑荒蔓延到南部核心區，而國王既無兵可調，也無糧可發。第四層是氣候：末期可能出現的全球暖化與歉收，壓垮了本已脆弱的收成。於是前二〇〇四／二〇〇〇年前後，埃蘭為主、包含安尚與希馬什基分遣隊的聯軍打到烏爾城下，發現這座城早已沒有可調的援兵，也撐不起第二次會戰。
causeEn: Taken apart, the destruction rests on four causes piled on top of one another. The first is structural: the Third Dynasty of Ur had bound the whole southern alluvial plain into a highly centralised administrative and redistributive system, and the bala rotation drew grain, reeds, livestock and labour from every province to the centre month by month; the moment a provincial governor sensed that royal power had weakened he recovered his autonomy, and the empire came apart from the periphery inward. The second is the frontier: no settled peace could be made with the Elamite kings, and the towns of Anshan and Shimashki under Elamite control revolted and submitted in turn; from the north-west the Amorite groups kept crossing the wall built by Shulgi and Shu-Sin and pressing in, and with them the levies, the taxes and the supply lines were all worn down. The third is the administrative and personnel collapse of the dynasty's last years: from the third year of Ibbi-Sin's reign the administrative centres of the core provinces produced no documents at all; after the fourteenth year the campaigns against Anshan, Huhnur and Susa ceased; Eshnunna and Isin broke away in turn, and famine reached the southern heartland, while the king had neither troops to move nor grain to distribute. The fourth is climate: a possible late-third-millennium global warming and the bad harvests that followed put the last weight on an already fragile yield. So it was around 2004/2000 BC that a coalition led by Elam, with contingents from Anshan and Shimashki, came down on Ur and found a city that had no longer any reserves to call up and could not survive a second pitched battle.
impact: 對蘇美爾世界，這場毀城是一條時代分界線。烏爾作為都城的地位就此終結，聖域與神塔上部遭劫掠與破壞，王室成員被押往蘇薩；烏爾納瑪的勝利石碑後來在蘇薩出土，一般認為正是那批戰利品之一，或在其後另一場埃蘭掠奪中被帶走。帝國的框架同時崩解：伊辛的伊什比埃拉以叛離總督的身分自立，建立伊辛王朝，自居為蘇美爾王統的合法繼承者，並把王朝的創始追到烏爾納瑪身上——蘇美爾王表正是這樣編成的，把王朝起點定在烏爾陷落之前，用以說明伊辛的正統性。阿摩利特人從此成為兩河流域的關鍵角色，伊辛、拉爾薩、埃什努那、馬里等城邦先後立國，最後由前十八世紀的古巴比倫完成統一。制度層面的後果同樣深遠：巴爾達稅制與中央牲畜調度體系隨王朝終止而廢止，書吏之家的傳統與王室文書的行政風格中斷，龐大泥板流散各地；城市層被破壞，烏爾此後只剩小居民點與神塔殘基。晚出的巴比倫編年史（如《魏德納編年史》）把這件事記為烏爾被毀、國王被擒，蘇美爾人的〈烏爾與蘇美爾毀滅哀歌〉則把它寫成神被褻瀆、城被踐踏的末日；後世學者因而把前二〇〇四年與阿卡德帝國的崩潰並列，視為蘇美爾城邦時代的終結。
impactEn: For the Sumerian world this destruction of a city is a line between eras. Ur's standing as a capital ended there and then: the sacred precinct and the upper stages of the ziggurat were looted and broken, members of the royal household were taken off to Susa, and the victory stele of Ur-Namma was later found at Susa, generally taken to be one of that booty or carried off in a later Elamite seizure. The framework of the empire came apart at the same time: Ishbi-Erra, the rebel governor of Isin, set himself up and founded the dynasty of Isin, claiming the legitimate succession of the Sumerian kings and tracing the founder of the line back to Ur-Namma. The Sumerian King List was compiled in just this way, dating the beginning of the dynasty to before the fall of Ur so as to establish the legitimacy of Isin. From then on the Amorites became the decisive actors in Mesopotamia: Isin, Larsa, Eshnunna and Mari raised states in turn, and the unification of the south was finally achieved by the Old Babylonian kingdom in the eighteenth century BC. The institutional consequences are just as deep: the bala system and the central livestock agency lapsed with the dynasty, the tradition of the House of Tablets and the administrative style of the royal documents was broken, and the mass of tablets was scattered. The city layer was destroyed, and Ur was afterwards no more than a small settlement among the ruins of its ziggurat. Later Babylonian chronicles, such as the Weidner Chronicle, record the matter as Ur destroyed and the king taken captive, while the Sumerian lament over the destruction of Ur and Sumer turns it into a day of sacrilege and of a city trampled underfoot; modern scholarship has accordingly set the year 2004 BC alongside the collapse of the Akkadian Empire as the end of the age of the Sumerian city-states.
result: 結果是烏爾的陷落與王朝的終止。前二〇〇四年（亦作前二〇〇〇年）前後，埃蘭聯軍攻破烏爾城，國王伊比辛與王室被擄往蘇薩，聖域遭掠劫焚燒，神塔上部受損，烏爾從此不再是大國的都城；行政檔案在同一時期全面中斷，烏爾第三王朝在《蘇美爾王表》上告終，而《蘇美爾王表》本身正是為伊辛王朝的合法性而編。接替者是幾個並立的地方政權：伊辛王朝以伊什比埃拉為首，約前二〇二八年至前一九〇〇年間統治南部；拉爾薩在西部崛起，埃什努那佔據北面平原，馬里控制中幼發拉底，阿摩利特人不再是邊患而是宗主。最終完成統一的是前十八世紀的古巴比倫，其君主自認承襲烏爾納瑪以來的王統。於是這場滅亡的真正落點，是蘇美城邦的行政與文化傳統被拆散、再由阿摩利特的巴比倫重新接續：蘇美爾語從此逐漸退為宗教與文學的語言，而曾經守在烏爾城牆上的那種束柄銅矛，在後世的兵器序列中退位給銅與青銅的矛斧、弓弩和更複雜的攻城器械。
resultEn: The result was the fall of Ur and the end of the dynasty. Around 2004 BC (also given as 2000 BC) the Elamite coalition broke into the city of Ur; the king Ibbi-Sin and the royal household were carried off to Susa, the sacred precinct was looted and burned, the upper stages of the ziggurat were damaged, and Ur was never again the capital of a great power. The administrative archives stopped at the same moment, and the Third Dynasty of Ur comes to an end in the Sumerian King List, a text compiled precisely to establish the legitimacy of the Isin dynasty. What replaced it were several local states standing side by side: the dynasty of Isin under Ishbi-Erra ruled the south from about 2028 to 1900 BC; Larsa rose in the west; Eshnunna held the northern plain; Mari controlled the middle Euphrates; and the Amorites were no longer a frontier menace but the masters. The unification was finally achieved by the Old Babylonian kingdom in the eighteenth century BC, whose kings counted themselves the heirs of the line begun by Ur-Namma. The real landing of this destruction, then, is that the administrative and cultural tradition of the Sumerian city-states was taken apart and then reconnected by Amorite Babylonia: Sumerian receded by degrees to the language of ritual and literature, and the bundled copper spear that had once held the wall of Ur gave way in the later order of weapons to copper and bronze spear and axe, to bow and arrow, and to the more elaborate machinery of siege.
